Camila / Rafael 

I can own the SOC2 / compliance and BAA items. Rafael can own the technical SIG answers (encryption, key mgmt, subprocessors). Initial draft answers below (we should review before sending to HealthSync):

SOC 2
- Status: SOC 2 Type II in effect covering period 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31. Report available under NDA; we can share a redacted version or provide a secure link.

BAA / PHI
- Redwood offers a BAA for customers requiring HIPAA compliance. Our hosted product can process PHI, but customers must enable certain isolation and retention settings. We'll include standard BAA language and note required configuration steps.

Subprocessors
- Current subprocessors: AWS (us-east-1), Sentry (error monitoring), Segment (analytics), Fastly (CDN). None of the subprocessors have routine access to plaintext customer data except support engineers under documented access controls; we'll provide a current list as an attachment.

Encryption & Key Management
- Data in transit: TLS 1.2+
- Data at rest: AES-256 default.
- Key management: Redwood-managed KMS by default (AWS KMS). Customer-managed keys (CMKs) available for Dedicated / Private deployments. Will mark SIG entries accordingly.

Data residency
- Hosted: multi-region; can restrict to US regions for Enterprise customers via Dedicated or Private deployments. EU regions available on request with contractual terms.

I compiled a draft of the SIG answers and saved as Redwood_SIG_answers-draft.xlsx 

Marissa
